guitar.evidence: David Roback of Mazzy Star used varied vintage electrics in dreamy/psych productions; no singularly iconic instrument is well documented.

tone.target: dreamy clean jangle with lush reverb and light chorus
tone.profile: dreamy clean jangle with lush reverb and light chorus
tone.summary: A dreamy, shimmering signal chain built around a US Deluxe amp model, utilizing Chorus for subtle movement, Plate reverb for lush atmosphere, and light compression to maintain clarity.
corrections: keep it cleaner than shoegaze wash
